faqs.a:
The authority to prohibit LSL and establish and implement a Lead Service Line Replacement
               Program is derived from the city's powers and authority as a home rule city under
               Article XX of the Colorado Constitution, and under article 15 of Title 31 of the Colorado
               Revised Statutes.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
